title: Amplicon Clean-Up Using SPRI Beads for RAPID Nanopore Kit RBK004
author: Nikki Freed
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgsrjwd6
materials: go to step #7 and repeat ethanol wash.

steps.title: Resuspend SPRI beads
steps.instruction: Vortex the Agencourt AMPure XP SPRI beads (Beckman Coulter Catalog #A63880) until the solution is a homogeneous brown colour, ensuring the beads are fully resuspended.

steps.title: Add beads to sample
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume (1:1) of room‑temperature SPRI beads to the sample tube (e.g., 50 µL beads to a 50 µL reaction) and mix gently by flicking or pipetting.

steps.title: Collect liquid by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Pulse‑centrifuge the tube briefly to bring all liquid to the bottom.

steps.title: Incubate mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at room temperature for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Bind beads on magnet
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack and incubate for 2 minutes (00:02:00) or until the beads have pelleted and the supernatant is completely clear.

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully remove and discard the supernatant without disturbing the bead pellet.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of freshly prepared, room‑temperature 80 % ethanol to the bead pellet.

steps.title: Mix and remove ethanol
steps.instruction: While the magnetic rack remains on the benchtop, rotate the tube 180°, allow beads to re‑form a pellet, then pipette off and discard the ethanol.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Pulse‑centrifuge briefly, then use a P10 pipette to remove as much residual ethanol as possible.

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: With the tube lid open, incubate for 1 minute (00:01:00) or until the pellet loses its shine (avoid over‑drying, which causes cracking).

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnetic rack and resuspend the pellet in 10 µL of 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0 containing 50 mM NaCl; mix gently by flicking and incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes (00:02:00).

steps.title: Transfer eluate
steps.instruction: Place the tube back on the magnetic rack, then transfer the clear eluate to a clean 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, taking care not to carry over any beads.
